items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I hear it in an extension of Paul Chambers... I noticed the younger bassists, you hardly hear them mention the great bassists like Paul Chambers... I can tell that they followed Paul.

ctx.x: Do you see yourself -- you talked about how Paul has influenced the, you know, the bassists. (inaudible). How do you see yourself as having influenced?

Well, I can't say. I've heard people say they've been influenced by me, a whole lot of them. It's gratifying and I've listened for certain things that I used to do, I can hear in some cats. You know, but like the way bass players are going now, I don't hear it as much, but I hear it in an extension of Paul Chambers, you know, which is beautiful.
